org.portico.lrc.services.object.data

Class OCInterest

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.lrc.services.object.data.OCInterest
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable

    public class OCInterest
extends Object
implements Serializable
    This class represents an interest in an particular object class (be it publication or subscription). Each instance contains a link to the OCMetadata instance it represents an interest in.

    Maintained along with each interest is a set of federate handles that hold the interest data, in addition to the set of attribute handles that they are interested in.

    Instances of this class are used by the InterestManager.

    • Method Detail

      • registerInterest

        public void registerInterest(int federateHandle,
                             Set<Integer> attributes)
        Registers the federate as having an interest in the given attribute handles. If the size of the set is 0, any previous interest will be removed (thus, un-pub or un-sub'ing). If there is already an interest set for the given federate handle, it will be replaced by the new set.

      • registerInterest

        public void registerInterest(int federate,
                             Set<Integer> handleSet,
                             RegionInstance region)
        Registers the federate as having an interest in the given attribute handles within the range of the provided RegionInstance. Unlike vanilla interest registrations, registrations with DDM data are cumulative (they don't necessarily replace the set of interests that existed before hand).

        If there already exists a set of attributes associated with the given region for the federate, it will be replaced by the provided set (effectively unsubscribing the provided federate from those attributes that were previously subscribe to, but which are not included in thhe provided set). If there is no existing set of attributes associated with the region, the association will be made. A single federate can be subscribed to the same attribute with more than one region associations at a time.

        Implementation Note: A null region is used to signal a registration that contains no DDM information. If null is passed for the RegionInstance, this will result in any existing interest to be replaced with the new attributes (rather than augmented).

        Implementation Note: If the provided attributes are null, no action will take place. If the provided set is empty, this is taken to be an implicit unsubscribe/unpublish and any association between the federate/region/attributes will be removed.

        Parameters:
        federate - The handle of the federate the interest registration relates to
        handleSet - The attributes to associate with the region
        region - The region to associate with the provided attribute handles

      • removeInterest

        public void removeInterest(int federateHandle,
                           RegionInstance region)
        Removes the interest in any attributes for the associated object class that have been linked to the given RegionInstance. If the federate has an interest associated with other regions for this object class, those will not be removed (unless the provided region is null). If the provided RegionInstance is null, then this request is treated as one that is not associated with DDM, and as such, will cause all interests (regardless of region) to be discarded for this object class (as it relates to the identified federate).

      • removeInterest

        public void removeInterest(int federateHandle,
                           Set<Integer> attributes)
        Removes any previously registered interested in the given attributes for the federate. If the given set is null or empty, the interest in all attributes for the class is removed.

      • getInterest

        public Set<Integer> getInterest(int federateHandle)
        Returns the set of attributes that make up the interest set for the given federate. If there is no registered interest, null is returned. Note that this set is unmodifiable.

      • getInterestWithDDM

        public RegionGroup getInterestWithDDM(int federateHandle)
        Return the RegionGroup associated with this interest for the provided federate. If the federate has no interest, return null.

      • getInterest

        public Set<Integer> getInterest(int federateHandle,
                                RegionInstance region)
        This method will return the set of attribute interests that are bound to the specified RegionInstance for the given federate. If there are no attributes associated with the RegionInstance, null will be returend.
